reasoning.summary: While the math model strongly favours the Sharks based on their Elo rating, Pythagorean form, and a dominant 5-game run metre advantage (+162.20), this is outweighed by the news that the Sharks are resting key stars Nicho Hynes, Blayke Brailey, and Teig Wilton (nrl.com). The Storm enter in strong form after a 46-20 win over Brisbane and are heavy market favourites ($1.36). Confidence is kept to a modest edge to account for the strong underlying ratings still favouring the home side.
